text: @kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail 为 DSH Web 提供可切换强度的 Ponytail 编码规则。系统提示规则可按会话通过 /ponytail 设为 lite、full、ultra 或 off，并可查看或重置。插件还注册审查、审计、技术债、收益参考和帮助技能，并提供原生设置页、模式选择器、状态带及用量仪表盘。无需额外 API Key。

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail adds switchable coding guidance to DSH Web. Use /ponytail to set lite, full, ultra, or off per session, check status, or reset. It registers review, audit, debt, gain, and help skills, plus native settings, a status band, and a usage dashboard. No extra API key is required.

Ponytail for DSH 的功能「会话强度切换」：通过 /ponytail lite、full、ultra 或 off 设置当前会话规则强度，也可查看状态、重置覆盖或保存全局默认值。
Ponytail for DSH 的功能「一次性开发技能」：注册代码审查、仓库审计、技术债、收益参考和帮助技能；使用对应 /ponytail-* 命令可将技能内容及备注提交给 agent。
Ponytail for DSH 的功能「原生控制界面」：在 DSH 设置页配置默认模式和可选技能，并在命令选择器中切换模式、查看状态或重置会话覆盖。
Ponytail for DSH 的功能「会话状态带」：在 composer 状态带展示当前模式等状态，并可呈现最近一次匹配的前台测试命令结果；该记录只保存在当前进程。
Ponytail for DSH 的功能「会话用量仪表盘」：在侧栏打开面板查看会话累计 token 用量、轮次和活动时长，并支持选择会话。

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · Ponytail for DeepSeek Harness：An unofficial port of Ponytail 5.3.3 ("lazy senior dev mode") to the DeepSeek
Harness (DSH). It keeps the upstream minimal-code rules exactly as written and
adds native DSH surfaces: a settings tab, a mode picker, a status band in the
composer, and a usage dashboard.

Upstream source: [DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)
(MIT). This is an unofficial port, not affiliated with upstream.

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · Ponytail for DeepSeek Harness：Beta. Host adapter and packaged-plugin tests pass on Windows with DSH 0.2.1-rc.3
and rc.5; macOS Desktop UI is not yet verified.

Compatibility peers allow DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3` and `<0.3.0`. CI checks the current
latest, alpha, and rc.3 daily, and future prereleases can still break APIs.

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · DSH Desktop — easiest：On a DSH version whose Plugins sidebar offers **Add plugin** (supported Desktop
versions): open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, enter
`@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail@5.3.3-dsh.6`, then review/install and enable it when
prompted. Fully quit DSH and reopen it, and create a new conversation.

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · DSH Desktop — easiest：The examples below install into a CLI-managed profile called `web`. They need the
DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 CLI. If you use the desktop app, use its bundled CLI instead (see
"Desktop app" below). Close any running DSH process after installing, then start it
again.

Pick one of four sources:

**Option 1 — Local link (development).** From a checkout of this repository:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$PWD"
```

The plugin stays linked to your checkout; edits load on the next start.

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · DSH Desktop — easiest：**Option 2 — GitHub source.** Installs from this repository's source tree:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:KB1SLN-Labs/dsh-ponytail
```

Append `#<commit>` to pin a version.

**Option 3 — Release tarball.** Download the packaged file and install it:

```powershell

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · https://github.com/KB1SLN-Labs/dsh-ponytail/releases/download/v5.3.3-dsh.6/kb1slnlabs-dsh-ponytail.tgz：dsh plugin --profile web add file:./kb1slnlabs-dsh-ponytail.tgz
```

Save the tarball in a stable folder that will not be deleted — you need it again for
reinstall or upgrade. The URL is version-pinned on purpose: this release is a
prerelease, so a "latest" download link would not resolve to it. To build the samepowershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail@5.3.3-dsh.6
```

The example pins the release so an install does not pick up stale cached `latest` metadata.

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · Desktop app：The desktop app ships its own CLI. An older globally installed CLI refuses the
reserved `desktop` profile; the bundled one works. Use the bundled CLI with the
`desktop` profile and the ordinary install:

```powershell
$dshDesktop = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'
& $dshDesktop plugin --profile desktop add @kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail@5.3.3-dsh.6
```

On macOS the Desktop app's bundled CLI lives inside the application bundle:

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · Desktop app：```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add @kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail@5.3.3-dsh.6
```

The bundled CLI supports the same alternate sources shown above — `github:`, a
`file:` tarball path, or a local `link:` checkout.

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · Everyday use：| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/ponytail` | Opens the mode picker (when the UI is available) |
| `/ponytail lite` / `full` / `ultra` / `off` | Sets the mode for this session |
| `/ponytail status` | Shows the current mode and where it comes from |
| `/ponytail reset` | Drops this session's override |

Modes: `lite`, `full` (upstream default), `ultra`, and `off`.

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · Everyday use：There are also one-shot commands: `/ponytail-review`, `/ponytail-audit`,
`/ponytail-debt`, `/ponytail-gain`, `/ponytail-help`. The review, audit, and other
skill commands start model work. Mode and subcommands like `status` or `help` do
not.

Profile settings survive a restart. Session overrides set with `/ponytail <mode>` reset
when the process restarts. See the [default precedence
reference](docs/REFERENCE.md#config--default-precedence) for environment and global
defaults.

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · What the numbers mean：- The dashboard shows whole-session usage as reported by the provider, grouped by
  the date each session was last updated. Filters decide which sessions get read;
  sessions with no update date appear only under **All**.
- Sessions without usable usage are listed as unavailable, and coverage counts say
  how many of the selected sessions carry usage.
- Active time is completed-turn elapsed time and includes waiting on approvals and
  tools.
- The test command shown in the status band is the current process's last recorded
  simple foreground test command. Its exit code is evidence for that command only,
  not proof about a whole suite.
- No cost or savings estimates are made for your sessions. `/ponytail-gain` shows the
  upstream benchmark reference.

@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail README · Development：To run the tests, point `DSH_ROOT` at the directory of an external rc3 host DSH
package install:

```powershell
$env:DSH_ROOT = '<abs path to the @deepseek-ai/dsh package dir>'
npm test        # node --test "test/*.test.mjs" — 64 checks, no model calls
```

See [validation scope](docs/REFERENCE.md#validation-scope) for what has and has not been
verified.
